## 1. New LLM Versions / Major AI Lab Tools

- **2026-08-13 — Google introduced Gemini 3.7 Flash**  
  Link: [Google — Introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/introducing-gemini-3-7-flash/)  
  Summary: Google announced Gemini 3.7 Flash as a Flash-series model for coding, agents, software engineering, knowledge work, and web development. It is available through Google Antigravity, Gemini API/AI Studio, Android Studio, Gemini Enterprise, and Gemini Spark.  
  Why it matters: Google is pushing its fast, lower-cost model tier further into agentic software work, tightening competition with OpenAI and Anthropic on developer workflows.

- **2026-08-13 — OpenAI previewed Ultrafast mode for GPT-5.6 Sol**  
  Link: [OpenAI — Previewing Ultrafast mode](https://openai.com/index/previewing-ultrafast/)  
  Summary: OpenAI previewed a new API service tier running GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 14× Standard processing speed, with claimed generation up to 750 output tokens per second, powered by Cerebras.  
  Why it matters: The move targets latency-sensitive AI products and suggests frontier-model competition is shifting from benchmark capability alone toward real-time deployment economics.

- **2026-08-13 — Google previewed Sheets canvas**  
  Link: [Google — Sheets canvas for Google Sheets](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/workspace/sheets-canvas-for-google-sheets-spreadsheets/)  
  Summary: Google showed Sheets canvas, a Workspace feature intended to help users turn spreadsheet data into more visual, interactive work surfaces.  
  Why it matters: AI-assisted productivity is moving deeper into existing office surfaces, where adoption can scale through familiar workflows rather than standalone chat interfaces.

## 2. FOSS / Open-Weight LMs & Tools

- **2026-08-13 — MiniMax released Music 3.0 as open weights**  
  Link: [MiniMax — Music 3.0](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-music-3-0-next-generation-open-weights-production-ready-versatile-music-model)  
  Summary: MiniMax released Music 3.0, an open-weights music generation model for complete songs up to five minutes from concepts and optional lyrics. The system uses structured captions, an 8B global LLM initialized from Qwen3.5-8B, a 0.6B local LLM, RVQ tokenization, flow matching, and Flow-VAE decoding.  
  Why it matters: Open-weight generative audio is becoming more production-grade, increasing pressure on closed music-generation providers and expanding self-hosted creative tooling.
